about: Minutes per scored episode on the Colab G4 (vLLM 0.32.0, both models FP8), development runs only (never evidence). Input to `simtest plan`. C3: session 5, all 18 scored episodes (unique), at about 12-14 at once. C0: session 4, 6 episodes at 6 at once, so scaled by 1.5 for 12 at once (an assumption, as in the n2-pilot estimate; LOG.md, 02-11-2026). Started-to-completed time per sample, from the .eval logs. Each attempt that failed is left out here; the failure rate is a parameter of `simtest plan`.
attempt_failures: Session 5's runs on the fixed timeouts (c3r, c3b2): 3 of 20 C3 attempts failed (simulator API timeouts at 187-265 min). The earlier session-5 runs failed for causes fixed since (docker exec timeouts, one error cancelling a task).
